$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the honeypot. Consumed by detection (allowlist of decoy objects to watch) AND remediation (guardrail so playbooks only ever act on these objects). Populated by the deploy pipeline from Terraform/Bicep outputs. Object IDs are GUIDs filled post-deploy. NEVER commit real secrets here.

reachableApp.$comment: Reachable escalation edge — the decoy app/SP the foothold OWNS and can take over (owned app requests unconsented RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory + carries pre-seeded cert/secret; the SP is the payoff, Owner of the decoy RG + Key Vault Secrets User). Consumed by detection (credential-add + SP sign-in + consent-grant rules) and response (disable-SP guard).

emergencyAccess.$comment: Standalone hollow admin the foothold can reset (Privileged Authentication Administrator scoped to a single-member AU). Consumed by detection (reset + sign-in rules) and response (disable-user guard).

allowlist.$comment: Identities/IPs that must NEVER trigger detection or remediation: break-glass GA, the activity agent, named-location CIDRs.
